title: Crear README base y registro de decisiones
acceptance: WHEN `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print `feature/xochitlgr`.
WHEN `git remote get-url upstream` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL print `https://github.com/VictorMC96/Full-Stack-Prueba-tecnica-Neology.git`.
WHEN `git check-attr eol -- backend/mvnw` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report `eol: lf`.
WHEN `git check-ignore -q backend/target/x.class` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, because build output is ignored.
WHEN `git check-ignore -q .claude/settings.json` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 1, because the agent workspace is committed.
WHEN `README.md` and `docs/decisiones.md` are read THE SYSTEM SHALL find the headings `## Cómo levantar` and `## Pruebas` in the first and the text `Spring Boot 4` in the second.
verify: git check-attr eol -- backend/mvnw | grep -q "eol: lf"
grep -q "## Cómo levantar" README.md && grep -q "## Pruebas" README.md

title: Configurar base del backend, esquema y datos
acceptance: WHEN the application context starts THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the Flyway migrations `V1__esquema.sql` and `V2__datos_iniciales.sql` and start with `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto` set to `validate`.

WHEN `BaseDatosMigradaTest` counts rows after startup THE SYSTEM SHALL report 6 rows in `vehiculos`, 7 in `estancias`, 1 in `periodos` and 3 in `acumulados_residentes`, with the `importe` column of `acumulados_residentes` summing 15.00.
WHEN `GET /actuator/health` is requested against the application started on a random port THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with `status` equal to `UP`.
WHEN `GET /v3/api-docs` is requested against the application started on a random port THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with a JSON body containing the key `openapi`.
WHEN the configuration properties are bound THE SYSTEM SHALL expose `acceso.tarifas.residente` as 0.05 and `acceso.tarifas.no-residente` as 0.50 through `TarifasProperties`.
WHEN `./mvnw -q -B -ntp verify` runs in `backend/` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with `spotless:check` bound to the `verify` phase and reporting no unformatted file.

title: Modelar dominio y estrategias de cobro
acceptance: WHEN `Placa.de("abc-123 d")` is called THE SYSTEM SHALL return a placa whose value is `ABC123D`.
WHEN `Placa.de` receives `AB`, an 11-character value, an empty string or a value containing `<` THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `PlacaInvalidaException`.
WHEN the time between entrada and salida is 0 seconds, 59 seconds or 10 minutes 5 seconds THE SYSTEM SHALL compute 0, 1 and 11 billable minutes respectively (every started minute counts).
WHEN `CalculadoraCobro` computes 11 minutes THE SYSTEM SHALL return 0.00 for `OFICIAL`, 0.55 for `RESIDENTE` and 5.50 for `NO_RESIDENTE`, each as a `BigDecimal` with scale 2.
WHEN `CalculadoraCobro` is constructed without a strategy for some `TipoVehiculo` constant THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `IllegalStateException` naming the missing type.
WHEN the sources under `backend/src/main/java/mx/neology/acceso/domain` are searched for `org.springframework` or `jakarta.persistence` THE SYSTEM SHALL find no match.

title: Implementar altas de vehículo y manejo de errores
acceptance: WHEN `POST /neo/vehiculos/oficiales` receives `{"placa":"abc-123"}` for an unknown placa THE SYSTEM SHALL return 201 with the header `Location: /neo/vehiculos/ABC123` and a body with `placa` `ABC123`, `tipo` `OFICIAL` and `dentro` `false`.

WHEN `POST /neo/vehiculos/residentes` receives a placa already registered as `OFICIAL` or `RESIDENTE` THE SYSTEM SHALL return 409 with `code` `VEHICULO_YA_REGISTRADO` and leave the row count of `vehiculos` unchanged.
WHEN `POST /neo/vehiculos/residentes` receives the placa of an existing `NO_RESIDENTE` vehicle THE SYSTEM SHALL return 201, change the `tipo` of that row to `RESIDENTE` and keep its `id`.
WHEN `POST /neo/vehiculos/no-residentes` receives a placa that already exists with any tipo THE SYSTEM SHALL return 409 with `code` `VEHICULO_YA_REGISTRADO`.

WHEN any of the three alta endpoints receives a placa that is blank, shorter than 3 characters after normalization or contains a character other than letters, digits, spaces and hyphens THE SYSTEM SHALL return 400 with content type `application/problem+json`, `code` `VALIDACION` and `errors[0].field` equal to `placa`.
WHEN the sources under `domain` and `application` are searched for `org.springframework` or `jakarta.persistence` THE SYSTEM SHALL find no match.

title: Registrar entradas y salidas con cálculo de cobro
acceptance: WHEN `POST /neo/estancias/entrada` receives a placa that does not exist THE SYSTEM SHALL return 201, create the vehicle with `tipo` `NO_RESIDENTE` and return an estancia whose `salida`, `minutos` and `importe` are `null`.
WHEN `POST /neo/estancias/entrada` receives a placa that already has an open estancia THE SYSTEM SHALL return 409 with `code` `VEHICULO_YA_DENTRO` and insert no row into `estancias`.

WHEN `POST /neo/estancias/salida` is received 10 minutes and 5 seconds after the entrada of a `NO_RESIDENTE` vehicle THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with `minutos` 10, `importe` 5.00 and `momentoCobro` `AL_SALIR`, and set `estancia_abierta_id` of the vehicle to null.

WHEN `POST /neo/estancias/salida` closes an 11-minute estancia of a `RESIDENTE` vehicle THE SYSTEM SHALL return `importe` 0.55 and `momentoCobro` `INFORME_MENSUAL` and add 11 minutes and 0.55 to the row of that vehicle in `acumulados_residentes` for the active period.
WHEN `POST /neo/estancias/salida` receives a placa that has no open estancia THE SYSTEM SHALL return 409 with `code` `VEHICULO_NO_DENTRO`.
WHEN `POST /neo/estancias/salida` receives a placa that does not exist THE SYSTEM SHALL return 404 with `code` `VEHICULO_NO_ENCONTRADO`.

title: Implementar inicio de mes y archivo de periodos
acceptance: WHEN `POST /neo/mes/iniciar` is called THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with `periodoAnterior.fin` set to the current server time and `periodoActual.fin` equal to `null`, and leave exactly 1 row of `periodos` with `activo` true.
WHEN a month is started THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the `periodo_id` of every closed estancia unchanged and delete no row from `estancias` or `acumulados_residentes`.

WHEN a `RESIDENTE` vehicle with accumulated minutes in the previous period closes an estancia after the month is started THE SYSTEM SHALL create a new `acumulados_residentes` row for the new period holding only the minutes and importe of that estancia.
WHEN a vehicle whose estancia was opened before the month was started registers its salida afterwards THE SYSTEM SHALL set the `periodo_id` of that estancia to the new active period.
WHEN a second row with `activo` true is inserted directly into `periodos` THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with a violation of the unique constraint `uq_periodos_activo`.

title: Generar informe de pagos en JSON y Excel
acceptance: WHEN `GET /neo/residentes/pagos` is requested with `Accept: application/json` against the preloaded database THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with 3 `filas` ordered `RES001`, `RES002`, `RES003`, `totalMinutos` 300 and `totalImporte` 15.00.

WHEN `GET /neo/residentes/pagos` is requested with `Accept: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet` THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with that content type and the header `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="informe-pagos-2026-09.xlsx"`.

WHEN the returned `.xlsx` is opened with Apache POI THE SYSTEM SHALL contain a sheet named `Pagos` whose first row is `Placa`, `Minutos`, `Importe`, followed by one row per resident and a last row `TOTAL` with 300 and 15.00 as numeric cells.
WHEN a `RESIDENTE` vehicle has no `acumulados_residentes` row in the active period THE SYSTEM SHALL list it with `minutos` 0 and `importe` 0.00.
WHEN vehicles of tipo `OFICIAL` or `NO_RESIDENTE` exist THE SYSTEM SHALL exclude them from `filas`.

title: Exponer listado y detalle y fijar calidad backend
acceptance: WHEN `GET /neo/vehiculos?page=0&size=2&sort=placa,asc` is requested against the preloaded database THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 with `content` holding `NOR001` and `OFI001` in that order, `totalElements` 6 and `totalPages` 3.
WHEN `GET /neo/vehiculos?placa=res` is requested against the preloaded database THE SYSTEM SHALL return exactly the vehicles `RES001`, `RES002` and `RES003`, filtered by the database query.

WHEN `GET /neo/vehiculos` receives `size=500` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer with `size` 100, and when it receives `sort=color,asc`, `page=-1` or `size=0` THE SYSTEM SHALL return 400 with `code` `PARAMETRO_INVALIDO`.

WHEN `GET /neo/vehiculos/RES001` is requested against the preloaded database THE SYSTEM SHALL return `tipo` `RESIDENTE`, `dentro` `false` and `acumuladoPeriodo` with `minutos` 210 and `importe` 10.50, and for the unknown placa `ZZZ999` THE SYSTEM SHALL return 404 with `code` `VEHICULO_NO_ENCONTRADO`.
WHEN `GET /neo/vehiculos/RES001/estancias` is requested against the preloaded database THE SYSTEM SHALL return its 2 estancias with the one entered on 2026-09-03 before the one entered on 2026-09-02.

WHEN `./mvnw -q -B -ntp verify` runs in `backend/` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with the JaCoCo `check` rule requiring a line-coverage ratio of at least 0.80 over `mx.neology.acceso.domain` and `mx.neology.acceso.application`, and with `OpenApiDocsTest` finding each of the 10 `/neo` routes in `/v3/api-docs`.

title: Montar base del frontend con Material y rutas
acceptance: WHEN `npm run build` runs in `frontend/` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with `@angular/material` and `@angular/cdk` listed in `package.json` and the theme compiled from `src/styles.scss` through `mat.theme`.

WHEN the router navigates to `/` THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to `/vehiculos`, and the paths `/vehiculos`, `/vehiculos/:placa`, `/operacion`, `/reporte` and `**` SHALL each resolve to a lazily loaded standalone component.
WHEN `placaValidator` validates `abc-123 d`, `AB` and `ABC<1>` THE SYSTEM SHALL accept the first and reject the other two with the error key `placa`.
WHEN an HTTP call fails with a `ProblemDetail` body THE SYSTEM SHALL open a `MatSnackBar` showing its `detail` and rethrow the error to the caller.

WHEN `VehiculosApi.listar` is called with page 1, size 25, sort `tipo,desc` and filter `res` THE SYSTEM SHALL issue a GET to `/neo/vehiculos` with the query parameters `page=1`, `size=25`, `sort=tipo,desc` and `placa=res`.
WHEN `npm run format:check` and `npm run test:ci` run in `frontend/` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 on both.

title: Construir listado de vehículos paginado
acceptance: WHEN `/vehiculos` loads THE SYSTEM SHALL request `GET /neo/vehiculos` with `page=0`, `size=10` and `sort=placa,asc` and render one table row per element of `content`, showing the placa with the CSS class `placa` and one chip for `tipo` and one for dentro or fuera.

WHEN the user changes the page or the page size in the paginator or clicks a sortable column header THE SYSTEM SHALL issue a new request carrying the new `page`, `size` and `sort` values instead of reordering rows in the browser.
WHEN the user types in the placa filter THE SYSTEM SHALL wait 300 ms after the last keystroke and then issue one request with the `placa` parameter and `page=0`.

WHEN the response has an empty `content` THE SYSTEM SHALL render the empty state with the text `No hay vehículos`, and with an active filter the text `Ningún vehículo coincide` plus a `Limpiar filtro` button.
WHEN the request fails THE SYSTEM SHALL hide the loading indicator and render `No se pudo cargar el listado` with a `Reintentar` button that repeats the request.
WHEN the page renders THE SYSTEM SHALL expose exactly one `h1` and a `mat-label` associated with the filter input.

title: Construir formularios de operación
acceptance: WHEN the entrada form is submitted with a valid placa THE SYSTEM SHALL send `POST /neo/estancias/entrada` with the normalized placa and show a snackbar containing the placa and the text `Entrada registrada`.

WHEN the salida form receives a successful response THE SYSTEM SHALL display the returned `minutos` and the `importe` formatted as currency, together with the label `Cobrar al salir`, `Se acumula al informe mensual` or `Sin cobro` according to `momentoCobro`.

WHEN a placa field holds a value that does not match `^[A-Z0-9]{3,10}$` after normalization THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the submit button disabled and, once the field is touched, show a `mat-error` referenced by the `aria-describedby` of the input.
WHEN the alta form is submitted with tipo `OFICIAL` or `RESIDENTE` THE SYSTEM SHALL send the request to `/neo/vehiculos/oficiales` or `/neo/vehiculos/residentes` respectively.

WHEN the user clicks `Iniciar nuevo mes` THE SYSTEM SHALL open a `MatDialog` asking for confirmation and send `POST /neo/mes/iniciar` only after the user confirms, sending no request when the user cancels.
WHEN a request fails with a `ProblemDetail` THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the typed value in the form and enable the submit button again.

title: Construir vista de detalle de vehículo
acceptance: WHEN `/vehiculos/RES001` loads THE SYSTEM SHALL request `GET /neo/vehiculos/RES001` and `GET /neo/vehiculos/RES001/estancias` with `page=0` and `size=10` and render the placa, the tipo chip and the dentro or fuera chip.
WHEN the vehicle is `RESIDENTE` THE SYSTEM SHALL show the card `Acumulado del periodo` with `minutos` and `importe`, and for any other tipo THE SYSTEM SHALL not render that card.
WHEN `estanciaAbierta` is not null THE SYSTEM SHALL show the card `Estancia abierta` with its entrada date.
WHEN the estancias paginator changes page THE SYSTEM SHALL request the new `page` from the server.
WHEN the detail request returns 404 THE SYSTEM SHALL render `Vehículo no encontrado` with a link to `/vehiculos` instead of the detail cards.
WHEN the estancias list is empty THE SYSTEM SHALL render `Este vehículo aún no tiene estancias`.

title: Construir reporte de residentes con descarga
acceptance: WHEN `/reporte` loads THE SYSTEM SHALL request `GET /neo/residentes/pagos` with `Accept: application/json` and render one row per element of `filas` plus a total row showing `totalMinutos` and `totalImporte`.

WHEN the user clicks `Descargar Excel` THE SYSTEM SHALL request `GET /neo/residentes/pagos` with `Accept: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet` and response type `blob`, and trigger a download named after the `Content-Disposition` header, falling back to `informe-pagos.xlsx`.
WHEN `filas` is empty THE SYSTEM SHALL render `No hay residentes registrados` and disable the download button.
WHEN the request fails THE SYSTEM SHALL render `No se pudo cargar el informe` with a `Reintentar` button.
WHEN the page renders THE SYSTEM SHALL show the start date of the period taken from `periodo.inicio` and exactly one `h1`.

title: Añadir CI y verificación de accesibilidad
acceptance: WHEN `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL define a job `backend` that runs `./mvnw -B -ntp verify` in `backend/` on Java 21 and a job `frontend` that runs `npm ci`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run test:ci` and `npm run build` in `frontend/` on Node 24.
WHEN the `backend` job runs on Linux THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the wrapper executable with `chmod +x mvnw` before invoking it.
WHEN `accesibilidad.spec.ts` renders each of the 5 page components THE SYSTEM SHALL find exactly one `h1` per page, a label for every `input` and an accessible name for every `button`.
WHEN the sources under `frontend/src/app` are searched THE SYSTEM SHALL find no occurrence of `innerHTML` and no hexadecimal color in any `.scss` file.
WHEN `npm run test:cov` runs in `frontend/` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and write a coverage report under `frontend/coverage/`.
verify: grep -q "npm ci" .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q "npm run format:check" .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q "npm run test:ci" .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q "npm run build" .github/workflows/ci.yml

WHEN the commands in the README are inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL state `./mvnw spring-boot:run` for `backend/`, `npm ci` followed by `npm start` for `frontend/`, and the URLs `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html` and `http://localhost:4200`.

WHEN `docs/capturas/` is listed THE SYSTEM SHALL contain the 6 files `lista.png`, `detalle.png`, `operacion-entrada.png`, `operacion-salida.png`, `iniciar-mes.png` and `reporte.png`, each referenced from `README.md`.

WHEN `docs/PR.md` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL contain the pull-request title `Prueba técnica Full Stack (feature/xochitlgr)`, the target `VictorMC96:main` and the manual fork, push and pull-request steps, none of which the builder executes.
WHEN the full gates run THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 on `./mvnw -q -B -ntp verify` in `backend/` and on `npm run format:check`, `npm run test:ci` and `npm run build` in `frontend/`.
